en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own move and get the same ship-or-rebuy comparison before you book anything
en.runTitle: London to Toronto: a 2-bedroom flat, 25 cubic metres and one cat, against a CAD 8,000 allowance

fields.label: Moving dates
fields.value: Arriving around 1 April 2027, moving from south London

fields.label: Immigration status, employment duration and earlier Canadian residence
fields.placeholder: e.g. 2-year work permit, 3-year contract, never lived in Canada

fields.label: Inventory
fields.value: About 25 cubic metres of furniture and boxes from a 2-bedroom flat, less if the big items are sold

fields.label: Cat's age, breed, measurements, health and country history
Spending ceiling and delivery flexibility
fields.placeholder: e.g. CAD 15,000 in total; furniture can arrive up to 3 months late

en.template: Plan our London–Toronto move for {dates}, {status}, {inventory}, {allowance} and {cat}. Compare shipping with rebuying, check customs and pet-flight requirements, and show cash needs including flights, housing and deferred purchases within {ceiling}. Plan only; do not contact, submit forms, book or pay.

phases.title: Collect public removal prices, customs rules, cat travel requirements and Toronto replacement prices
phases.note: Removal quotes, customs, cat entry rules, airline policies and rebuying costs
phases.judgment: It refused to assume the new job counts as settling in Canada: whether employment runs past 36 months decides which customs rules apply, so the plan is marked as dependent on the couple's actual status.

phases.title: Build three costed plans, a timeline and the report page, while a colleague recomputes the numbers
phases.note: Ship a full container, ship 10 m³ shared, or take suitcases and air freight and rebuy
phases.judgment: The independent recount ran 155 checks. It caught two summary figures that were one cent off and a delivery window that stopped at July when shared shipping can arrive as late as 4 August. The final page carries both fixes.

phases.title: Final checks and page tests at desktop and phone widths
phases.judgment: It kept the cat's cabin seat out of the headline number: the recommended plan costs CAD 12,951.54 with the cat in cargo, and CAD 8,771.54 only if the cat may fly in the cabin, which no airline source confirmed for a London departure.

workers: Collected public prices and transit times from four removal companies
Read Canada's official customs rules for settlers' goods, the declaration forms and the goods-to-follow timing
Checked what Canada and the UK require to bring a cat in, plus airline pet rules and shipping costs
Recomputed the cost model independently and checked each figure against the page and its sources
